metaData.originalTitle: 还人肉查？日志诊断 Skill：用 AI+MCP 一键解决 bug
metaData.title: Stop Manual Log Checking: Diagnose Bugs with AI + MCP in One Click
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to automate the fixed workflow of log querying, code analysis, and root cause localization using the MCP protocol and Claude Code Skill, enabling one-click bug diagnosis.
metaData.summary: Based on the practical experience of the Dewu technology team, this article proposes an engineering solution for automating backend bug diagnosis using AI. The core idea is to encapsulate the fixed and time-consuming process of 'checking logs → extracting key information → scanning code → locating the problem' through the MCP (Model Context Protocol) and Claude Code's Skill mechanism. The article first explains the principles and configuration of the log platform MCP, allowing AI to obtain dynamic log data in real-time. It then focuses on the design of the /log-diagnosis Skill, including its complete execution chain (from traceId time estimation, paginated log retrieval, cross-service analysis to code localization), core capabilities (automatic token management, cross-service analysis, code linkage), and detailed installation and configuration steps. Through a real-world SQL bug case, the article demonstrates how AI automatically pulls logs, reconstructs the call chain, extracts SQL, and discovers a subtle bug caused by inconsistent field logic, ultimately locating the code and providing a fix. Finally, the article summarizes the key points for diagnosis efficiency and highlights the core idea: transforming an engineer's experience and workflow into reusable AI capabilities is the core competitiveness of engineers in the AI era.

mainPoints.point: Using the MCP protocol to allow AI to call external log platforms in real-time, breaking through static context limitations.
mainPoints.explanation: As a standardized tool invocation protocol, MCP enables Claude Code to communicate with the log platform via SSE long connections, obtaining dynamic log data in real-time. This is the foundation for automated diagnosis.

mainPoints.point: Leveraging the Claude Code Skill mechanism to solidify the diagnosis process into a reusable engineering capability.
mainPoints.explanation: A Skill is essentially an operation manual (SOP) for the AI. By defining behavioral norms through Markdown files in the .claude/skills/ directory, it transforms one-time conversations into repeatable commands, ensuring stable execution quality.

mainPoints.point: AI outperforms humans in discovering 'inconsistent logic in similar fields' types of bugs through horizontal comparison.
mainPoints.explanation: In the case study, the AI could compare query conditions for multiple fields in the SQL and discover that the customer_tag field was missing an empty string check. This subtle difference, easily overlooked by humans due to experience bias, was precisely identified by the AI.

keyQuotes: The process of debugging—checking logs, extracting key information, finding code, and analyzing the cause—has a fixed logic and tedious steps, but doesn't require much creative thinking. This kind of work is exactly what AI is best at taking over.

The essence of a Skill is 'writing an operation manual for the AI.' The more detailed it is and the clearer the constraints, the more stable the AI's execution quality. This is essentially the same as writing documentation for humans.
In the AI era, an engineer's core competitiveness is not just 'being able to write code,' but 'being able to transform their own experience and processes into reusable AI capabilities.'
